en.t: Out of deep love for my child, I have ventured to write to you so frankly.
Please forgive me for any presumption in doing so!"

units.source_text: 源氏也看了这信，对紫姬说道：“这信十分可怜，你该写回信表示遵嘱。”

en.t: Genji also read the letter and said to Lady Murasaki, "This letter is truly pitiable; you should write back and show that you will comply."

units.source_text: 便命侍女们拿出酒肴来，款待送信使者。

en.t: He then ordered the ladies-in-waiting to bring out wine and food, and entertained the messenger who had delivered the letter.

units.source_text: 紫姬有些困窘，不知回信如何措词才好。

en.t: Lady Murasaki felt somewhat embarrassed and did not know how best to phrase her reply.

units.source_text: 她认为不必郑重其事地表示心服情愿，所以只是述说心中所感：

en.t: She felt there was no need to make a formal show of willing obedience, so she simply expressed what was in her heart:
